categories.label: Research verification
categories.evidence: Four requests explicitly call for primary sources or verification; no friction is reported. Covered denotes request coverage only; successful verification is unobserved.

categories.label: Visual design
categories.evidence: One review request; below the two-entry minimum.

categories.label: Writing

categories.label: Tool execution
categories.evidence: Four execution requests report failures: two include rendering timeouts, one an access denial, and one a server-tool error. Causes and eventual recovery are unobserved.

surprising: Tool execution is the clearest weakness despite explicit verification requirements elsewhere: all four relevant execution entries report failures, including two timeouts, an access denial, and a server-tool error. This measures reported workflow friction, not its cause or the ability to recover.
headline: Research verification: covered requests. Tool execution: critical reported friction.
strongestBasis: Research verification is the strongest measured category by reported-friction ranking, not frequency or demonstrated success. Four relevant requests contain no reported friction; the other measured categories contain explicit negative feedback.
limitations: Results describe the supplied sample, not the model's intelligence.
The sample contains requests and user-reported friction, without completed outputs or independent outcome checks.
Task frequency alone is not evidence of capability. Covered means repeated task coverage without reported friction, not verified proficiency.
Categories with fewer than two relevant entries are Not measured.
Recommendations are relevant to observed gaps rather than confirmed missing installations.
